title: Hurtful Words: Quantifying Biases in Clinical Contextual Word Embeddings
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical quantification of algorithmic fairness (bias) across demographic groups using statistical metrics. While fairness is an ethical concept, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark moral frameworks, ethical reasoning, or religious concepts. Its primary contribution is the measurement of performance disparities and the application of a technical debiasing method, not an evaluation of the model's ability to reason about ethics.
